import sys
s = sys.stdin.readline().strip()
t = sys.stdin.readline().strip()
prefixes_s = set(s[:i] for i in range(1, len(s)+1))
prefixes_t = set(t[:i] for i in range(1, len(t)+1))
distinct_strings = set(prefix_s + prefix_t for prefix_s in prefixes_s for prefix_t in prefixes_t)
print(len(distinct_strings))
